haraj.label: حراج
haraj.access: READ-DIRECT (browser). All 19 main sections enumerated; each section's branch list opened individually and expanded through its «أظهر المزيد» control.
haraj.yield: 19 main sections. Branches exist in only 6 of them (السيارات، العقار، الأجهزة، مواشي وحيوانات وطيور، الأثاث، مستلزمات شخصية). The other 13 — including مكتبة وفنون and صيد ورحلات — are leaf-only and expose no branch at all.
haraj.caveat: The حراج السيارات branch list interleaves ~50 CAR MAKES (تويوتا، هونداي، لكزس …) with structural branches. Makes are a facet, not a taxonomy level; they are excluded from the catalog and belong to the vehicles `الماركة` field (D-02 §2). Importing them would have manufactured ~50 fake subcategories and hit 110 by accident.

almazad-alhar.label: المزاد الحر
almazad-alhar.access: READ-DIRECT (browser). Plain HTTP fetch returns 403; a real browser session returns the full page. Complete category→subcategory tree extracted from its own navigation links.
almazad-alhar.yield: 19 main categories, ~160 subcategories, two levels, fully named.
almazad-alhar.caveat: D-02 §1.1 lists this platform as inaccessible and therefore used only via search snippets. That is no longer true and was the single largest recoverable gap in the prior evidence base.

emiratesauction.label: Emirates Auction
emiratesauction.yield: 12 top-level auction categories including ساعات ومجوهرات، خيول و أنعام، السفن والبوارج، بضائع متنوعة، عقارات.
emiratesauction.caveat: Its only deep level is licence plates, split by EMIRATE (أبوظبي، دبي، الشارقة، عجمان، الفجيرة، رأس الخيمة، أم القيوين). That is a UAE jurisdiction split and does not transfer to a Saudi product; it is NOT imported as seven plate subcategories.

soum.label: Soum
soum.yield: ~18 subcategories, almost entirely electronics, plus لوح سيارات and سيارات.
soum.caveat: Corroborates the electronics branch densely and contributes nothing to any other category.

infath.label: إنفاذ (Infath)
infath.access: READ-DIRECT (fetch). Note the domain is infath.gov.sa; infath.sa does not resolve.
infath.yield: One asset type visible on the public listing surface: عقارات.
infath.caveat: D-02 cites إنفاذ as one of the two platforms carrying a منقولات متنوعة escape hatch. The public surface read on 2026-08-15 exposed only real estate, so that specific claim is NOT corroborated by this read. Recorded as an open provenance question, not silently dropped — see PROVENANCE.md §6, O-F0-4.

mazadak.label: Mazadak
mazadak.access: READ-DIRECT (fetch), ENGLISH ONLY. The /ar path returns 404.
mazadak.yield: Vehicles, Heavy Machinery, Scrap, Furniture, Liquids.
mazadak.caveat: Because only English labels were obtained, this source can corroborate that a CONCEPT is auctioned; it can never supply an Arabic label. No catalog label is derived from it.

mazad-om.label: مزاد عُمان
mazad-om.access: FAILED — TLS error, 'unable to verify the first certificate'. Not read.
mazad-om.caveat: Reproduces the SSL failure D-02 §1.1 recorded. No row cites this source.

opensooq.label: السوق المفتوح
opensooq.caveat: Reproduces the 403 D-02 §1.1 recorded. No row cites this source.

prototype.label: categories.html (owner-approved prototype)
prototype.yield: 13 main categories with slugs; 60 named subcategory chips in the grid; 12 anonymous +N placeholders; 1 further named subcategory (فضة) visible only in the picker; a 13-row category-field table.
prototype.caveat: Its headline claims 110 subcategories. Its own grid accounts for 72. See PROVENANCE.md §4 — this is the F0 blocker.

d02.label: docs/decisions/D-02-categories.md
d02.yield: The 13 main categories and their slugs, marked DECIDED by the product owner on 2026-08-15. Also an 11-row category-field table.
d02.caveat: Its field table omits `outdoors` and `misc` entirely and leaves `fashion` as '(per the prototype's table)'. categories.html supplies all three. The catalog takes the prototype as the field source and records the divergence.
